data.name: Adamant of Honor
data.detailed_description:
Earth has become a lifeless wasteland where oceans have dried up, forests have vanished, and abandoned Adamant Research Facilities continue to produce deadly robots and monstrous experiments.

Play as Captain Mercer, a former elite soldier on a mission to destroy five hostile research facilities, recover the 12 Adamant Stones, and stop a rogue force from using their power to dominate the planet.

Scavenge weapons, equipment, and valuable resources as you complete dangerous extraction missions, battle powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets behind the Adamant Project. Every successful extraction brings humanity one step closer to restoring clean energy, water, and life to Earth.

Features

  • Sci-Fi Third-Person Action – Engage in intense combat against robots, mutants, and enemy forces.

  • Scavenge to Survive – Start with nothing and fight your way to better weapons, armor, and gear.

  • Harness the Adamant Stone – Unlock its devastating potential to gain an edge in battle.

  • Atmospheric Setting – Explore a massive secret facility filled with danger, mystery, and chaos.

  • Boss Encounters – Face powerful enemies, including monstrous creations and the faction’s leader.
